_about: Speed budget for the shop (13 Nov 2026). Read by scripts/speed-check.mjs (npm run speed / speed:lab / speed:live). Sizes are compressed (gzip -9) KB, as phones download them. A change that goes over a limit needs a written reason and the owner's OK before it ships; raise a limit only in the same pull request, with the reason in its description. The rules behind these numbers: Ruhi_Speed_Framework.md in the Ruhi Collections folder.

lab._about: Lighthouse 13 mobile defaults (Moto G Power, slow 4G: 150 ms, 1.6 Mbps, 4x CPU), a fresh browser each run like a shopper arriving from an ad, the median of 3 runs, GA4/Meta hits blocked. 'max' is the never-worse-than line for today's site; 'goal' is where the plan is heading (Google's 'good' line for LCP is 2.5 s, measured on real phones).
